scope: Correct generated HEADER and object-frame test controls; no production codec or support-claim change.
evidence: The generated AC1032 HEADER declares 519 bytes with a CRC offset of 543: its declared count excludes the four-byte high-size word. The compatibility reader therefore reports the expected four-byte profile warning.

ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 9 describes the versioned HEADER size word; sections 20.1 and 20.2 define R2010+ handle-stream sizes in bits, including end padding. A handle stream starting inside a byte need not have a byte-multiple bit count.
changes: Date/time controls require the exact compatibility-warning kind, severity and four-byte delta for the generated AC1027 and AC1032 profiles while preserving value assertions and clean diagnostics for earlier profiles.

Construct and CRC-seal a truly canonical HEADER control before testing that a distant forged trailer cannot rescue a surplus canonical envelope. The alternate profile retains its existing CRC, malformed-body, suffix, rollback and retry checks.

For the modern viewport object-frame control, compare handle bits directly against body bits and require an actual non-byte-aligned AC1027 witness. Offset ordering, nonoverlap, bounds and frame CRC checks remain in force.
validation: The complete local libdxfrw_dwg_reader_matrix_tests executable passes with zero assertion failures; the previous local run had five.
The header-date-time-validation, header-version-envelopes and viewport-handles-section focused selectors pass.
limits: Local generated controls do not establish independent producer interoperability or promote support claims.
The broader native roundtrip and hosted qualification remain open; the hosted qualification status overlay also needs its implementation digest refreshed.
